mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when RSAFS declines > 2% over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO increases > 1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% each in a month signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase > 5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in one month signals labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 70% of instances when UNRATE decreases > 0.3%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
